output.summary: Volume, not price, drives the agency increase (77% volume, 23% rate pass-through of the wage-index escalator). RN vacancies and resignations rose steadily from Q1 2024, long before St. Brennan's opened in March 2026, and the 2025 bonus did not reduce vacancies. Agency RNs cannot charge or precept, so their use shifts charge and orientation load onto permanent RNs, which is linked to later resignations. The 4 West pilot, where reduced load coincided with falling exhaustion and resignations while pay was unchanged, supports this loop. The proposed bonus, funded by cutting charge and preceptor differentials, and the agency bar on falls units would add load and are harmful. Extending the 4 West workload model is preferred. Time-to-hire remains unresolved because withdrawals are not recorded.
